checks.finding: Core terms are concrete: concept id pattern is an exact regex (REQ-002: `^CONCEPT-[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*$`), validator inputs/outputs are pinned (REQ-004: single JSON path, exit 0/non-0, one violation per stderr line), and the self-contradiction check is scoped to exact string equality (REQ-004(h): '同一文字列'), removing case for divergent implementer interpretation. Style-only descriptors ('PascalCase'/'kebab-case' for name/context, REQ-002) lack an explicit regex the way id does, but REQ-006 and Risk R2 already mandate a fixture-driven drift-lock between the schema file and the hand-rolled validator, which forces convergence rather than leaving it to independent implementer judgment, so this does not rise to a blocking two-implementer divergence.

No direct conflict found between goals, ACs, constraints, and non-goals. REQ-007's 'zero-byte-change to v1/consumers/11 suites' is consistent with REQ-001-006's additive-only v2 file and AC-015's non-regression check; the single-context-ownership rule in REQ-002 does not conflict with distinguished_from's cross-context reference use (INV-003, AC-005); the Assumptions section's hook-unavailable/v1-nonexistence claims are corroborated by INV-009/INV-010 rather than contradicted elsewhere in the document.

requirements.md's Edge Cases section explicitly asserts two validator-observable behaviors that have no corresponding entry in acceptance-tests.md's AC-001..AC-015 / TEST-001..TEST-015 table: (1) 'concepts が空配列: v2 では invalid（minItems 1）' has no AC/TEST exercising an empty concepts[] fixture (AC-014 only covers essence/evidence/responsibilities field-level omissions, not the top-level array itself), and (2) '契約ファイルが10MBを超える等の異常入力: validator は fail-closed で非0終了（best-effort パースをしない）', which corresponds to validator duty (a) 'JSONとして可読' in REQ-004, also has no AC/TEST. Downstream failure mode: a task author implementing acceptance tests from this document has no acceptance criterion to encode either behavior, so a validator that accepts an empty concepts[] array or that hangs/crashes instead of exiting non-zero on oversized or malformed input would ship without any test catching the regression. This is a gap in acceptance-criteria observability, which is this gate's own artifact (acceptance-tests.md), not a later-stage concern. Severity Major per calibration's 'missing observable acceptance criterion.'

The three Assumptions (hook-inactive session per INV-010, v1-instance-nonexistence per owner decision/INV-009, and no-schema-change-by-later-phases) are each backed by investigation evidence. Open Questions OQ-001..OQ-004 each carry a concrete proposal; OQ-003 (essence required) and OQ-004 (v2-only validator with explicit v1 rejection) are already adopted verbatim into the operative requirement text (REQ-002 lists essence as required; REQ-004(b) and AC-012 fix the v1-rejection behavior), so a downstream implementer has an unambiguous target regardless of the tracking table's 'Open' label. OQ-001 (v1 file fate) and OQ-002 (CI/run-all registration) are explicitly deferred to a later phase / kept at existing-convention default (INV-007), which does not block Phase 0 design or task decomposition.

Skip condition met: this Phase 0 feature adds only a schema file, a read-only validator, and tests. No new human-approval, governance, or irreversible-change boundary is introduced or implied in requirements.md or acceptance-tests.md, so no such boundary is in scope for this check.

The spec gives a design/implementation-policy reviewer concrete, non-inventable content to evaluate: an explicit field table with types/required/patterns, a fully enumerated validator check list (a)-(i) in REQ-004, a CLI contract (single JSON path in, exit 0/non-0, one-violation-per-stderr-line out), and named fixture requirements per REQ-005/REQ-006 tied 1:1 to REQ-004's checks. The Edge Cases prose itself already states the intended empty-concepts and oversized-input behaviors (the gap identified under EDGE-CASE-COVERAGE is specifically a missing acceptance-test entry, not missing product behavior a design reviewer would have to invent), so downstream readiness of the requirement content is intact.
